run_get_filelist: run the python module to generate a file list of all mp4 videos in the dev and test splits
run_prep_wav: run the python module to extract wav audio from mp4 videos using ffmpeg with sharded parallel processing
run_vox_prepare_step1: run the python module with step 1 to scan a VoxCeleb2 directory and write a file list manifest
run_vox_prepare_step2: run the python module with step 2 to extract audio from VoxCeleb2 videos using a specified ffmpeg binary
review_prep_wav: review the python prep_wav function that extracts audio from video files using ffmpeg with rank-based sharding
